title: The prisoner exchange refused
summary: Helaman receives Ammoron's offer to trade the prisoners for Antiparah, replies that he will exchange prisoners only, and Ammoron refuses. Helaman's force prepares to move against the city.

explicit_facts.text: Ammoron offers Antiparah in exchange for the prisoners of war.
Helaman replies that his forces can take Antiparah and will exchange prisoners only.
Ammoron refuses the reply, and Helaman's force prepares to go against Antiparah.

prohibited_inventions: Do not depict a face-to-face meeting or invent spoken words; the communication is by epistle.

title: Antiparah falls

title: The prisoners rebel
summary: Helaman's numerous prisoners break out and fight with stones, clubs, or whatever they can seize. Helaman's force kills more than two thousand after their surrender. Faced with the choice to kill or guard them sword in hand to Zarahemla, and with provisions barely sufficient, the force confronts a serious decision.

title: The men sent with the prisoners return
